views.name: Sandton and Rosebank
views.for: Business visitors and a first base

hex_levels.note: The whole-city view: about 1 km hexagons, about 960 in all.
Region views such as Sandton and Rosebank: about 420 m hexagons, about 6,000 in all, in hexes-region.svg.
Zoomed-in detail views only (for example Sandton): about 100 m hexagons, loaded for the part of the map on screen.

landmark.note: The ring road (N1 Western, N3 Eastern and N12 Southern Bypass) is always shown, above the area shading, in every view.
